title: A control character in a document property makes every save fail
symptom: the setters of core properties (title, author, subject, keywords, description, category...), application properties and custom properties succeed, then every save fails with InvalidXmlCharacter on docProps/core.xml, docProps/app.xml or docProps/custom.xml; the CLI meta set reports the error and writes nothing (document variables and the other settings strings refuse such a character when set)
workaround: remove the characters XML 1.0 cannot carry (control characters other than tab, line feed and carriage return, U+FFFE, U+FFFF) before setting a value; to save again, set the value clean or remove it (Rust set_core_properties, set_application_properties or remove_application_properties, remove_custom_property; Python doc.core_properties.title = ..., doc.app_properties.company = None, del doc.custom_properties[name])
